name: dmengine-fumo-update
description: Mode C FUMO install request: after the authenticated DD/DP download and install notification, the mock answers the DM report session with a FUMO Update Exec. The real dmengine queues the command on ./ManagedObjects/FUMO/Update and rejects the structural DP with 0x6011 / FUMO error 24593. No update-complete state is reached and no install is claimed.
